title: Job Change
notes: Job Change unlocks at Rank C: pick one of two specializations for your power.
Flame: Inferno Lord or Phoenix Blade. Storm: Thunder God or Tempest Dancer. Void: Abyss Warden or Void Reaper. Blood: Crimson Berserker or Blood Sovereign.
Each job gives a passive bonus and makes one skill stronger (more damage, more hits, longer buffs or extra crystals).
Your job is shown under your name and in the Champion screen. Switching later costs Gold.
